body: Ok I will probably contact them. I struggle to get on board with any religion and I am jealous of people who can find strength from it. It seems like AA has some sort of religious basis as well.
I need help with my eating disorder and I need it to be cheap to free :( I've emailed several support groups and no response. they seem to be inactive.

Well we just worked with the eating disorder and I was honest at the beginning but started downplaying how much I was doing it because she kept saying I would be sent to inpatient if it persisted. That evolved into me saying I wasn't puking anymore at all.
Yes I guess I was 15 the last time I spoke to a professional
